label: Wykop
terms_note: Regulamin bans undisclosed advertising and astroturfing; the community downvotes promotion hard. NSFW content must set adult.

auth: 1. Register an application in the Wykop developer panel → `appkey` + `secret`.
2. `POST /auth` {key, secret} → app JWT (Bearer). "Każda aplikacja … musi autoryzować się swoim unikatowym
3. User authorization: `GET /connect` → redirect the tenant to Wykop, callback returns a user token (`connect`

endpoints.call: POST /links/draft` {url} → key; `POST /links/draft/{key}` {title, description, tags[], photo, adult, selected_image}

reference.limits: - Per-user limits on adding entries, links, related links, comments and votes → HTTP 400 `limit_exceeded` (values not in the spec); app JWT vs user JWT scopes. - Wykop regulamin: undisclosed advertising / astroturfing is banned and the community downvotes promotion hard — posts must be genuinely useful; NSFW flag (`adult`).

fields.name: app_key
fields.help: Wykop application key (appkey) issued for the app.

fields.name: app_secret
fields.help: Secret paired with the app key.

adapter.terms: Wykop API v3 (beta): 'Każda aplikacja korzystająca z API musi autoryzować się swoim unikatowym identyfikatorem (appkey) i hasłem (secret) w celu otrzymania tokena JWT'.

read_comments.note: GET /entries/{entryId}/comments (Mikroblog - Komentarz) with the application JWT: page and limit ('Limit obiektów na stronie', 1-50, default 25). post_id is a microblog entry id; created_at is 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM[:SS]' (Warsaw time); votes are in raw.

analytics_post.note: GET /entries/{entryId} 'Zwraca wpis z mikrobloga'; metrics are the entry's votes.up / votes.down and comments.count.

not_offered.me: Needs a user JWT: user sessions come from POST /refresh-token with a nested JSON body {data: {refresh_token}} that answers a NEW refresh_token every time ('otrzymujemy nowy token JWT oraz nowy refresh_token'); the runtime's session login cannot keep that rotated token and oauth2_refresh_token sends a flat grant_type=refresh_token body. Missing: a refresh-token grant with a nested JSON body and rotation read from data.refresh_token.
not_offered.publish_text: POST /entries needs a user JWT (see me: rotating refresh token in a nested JSON body).
not_offered.publish_image: Needs a user JWT (see me) and media are first uploaded through POST /media/photos (multipart upload or URL) before the entry.
not_offered.reply_comment: POST /entries/{entryId}/comments needs a user JWT (see me).
not_offered.read_mentions: Mentions are user notifications (GET /notifications/entries) and need a user JWT (see me).
not_offered.delete: DELETE /entries/{entryId} needs a user JWT (see me).
